fullDescription: Default dashboard-home view with repository navigation, Copilot prompt composer, feed repository cards, event detail, and changelog panels. It accepts a serializable state prop with the default state and composes the shared dashboard header and repository cards.
Reusable dark application header with GitHub branding, search input, account control, and locally interactive utility buttons that expose pressed states.

Reusable repository collection card accepting a title, repository metadata items, and initial star state. Each card renders repository descriptions, language and star metadata, and an interactive star control.
